name: Infinity
review:
The pixel art is pretty and leads to nice initial impressions along with the passwords for custom difficulty settings.

The fakemons and story are 'meh', and the game is missing out on QoL from other Pokemon fan gamesr. A "cheese merchant" exists as a password in lieu of an EV/IV setter, but there is no easy way to lower EVs other than berry farming (requiring you to find the berry first too).

Decent, but leaves some stuff to be desired.
